entries.zh: 卦：占卜用的卦签、卦象（卜卦问神之吉凶）
entries.en: divining lots; to cast lots to divine fortune (卦, 卜卦)
entries.notes: R栏空，M首音[疑:tia/cia]且末音节T99；「卜卦」(po-kua)与卦义及西栏suertes de adivinas相合。

entries.zh: 极（原字「極」，极点、极致）；西栏若按本页suertes词族读作「凶卦、恶签」则与汉字不合，释义存疑
entries.en: extreme, utmost point (極); read within this page's suerte family it would be 'unlucky/devil's lot' — columns irreconcilable, doubtful
entries.notes: 西栏fuertes疑为suertes词族重复记号之误读，与「極」义不合；音写pue gi pue未能解，T99。

entries.zh: 间（原字「間」：间隔、中间）；西栏义当为「签分事物」，与汉字不合，释义存疑
entries.en: interval, between, among (間); Spanish column reads '(lots) of anything whatever', which does not match — doubtful
entries.notes: L与H语义无法互证（西栏疑重复记号，汉字为間），故降low。

entries.zh: （首字[疑:间/阉]未定）分：抽签分派、分份均分
entries.en: to divide by lot, share out (…分); first character uncertain [間/閹]
entries.notes: 首字[疑:間/閹]且首音节T99；西栏fuertes按本页suertes词族解读为「签分」。

entries.zh: 本分：各人应得之份、份内之职分
entries.en: each one's lot or share; one's own duty, proper portion (本分)
entries.notes: 首字[疑:本/分]；西栏「每人一份」与「本分」义相合，重复记号按suertes词族解读。

entries.zh: 耐：忍耐、忍受（耐心承受）
entries.en: to endure, bear with patience (耐; 忍耐)
entries.notes: M中音节[疑:xim/gim]（当为「忍」）且T99；R栏空。

entries.zh: 吞忍：忍气吞声、默默忍受（次字残缺）
entries.en: to swallow and endure in silence (吞忍); second syllable damaged in the original
entries.notes: M次字[残]且T99；据音写lun并与第20条互证，次字当为「忍」。

entries.zh: 饶：饶恕、宽饶（容让放过，不加计较）
entries.en: to forgive, pardon, spare; to bear with, let off (饒)
entries.notes: M首音[疑:x/s]且T99；「饶」之容让义与sufrir容受义相合。

entries.zh: 容：容忍、宽容（容让他人，不加禁止）
entries.en: to tolerate, put up with; to allow, indulge (容)

entries.zh: 堪：经得起、忍受得住
entries.en: to be able to bear, stand, endure (堪)
entries.notes: 仅音调未定（T99）致降；L/H/M三栏字义清晰相合。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕原字「裕」（宽裕、富足）与西栏sufrir不合，正文与边注均残缺
entries.en: damaged in the original, gloss doubtful; abundant, ample (裕) — inconsistent with 'sufrir', body text and marginal note both fragmentary
entries.notes: M正文[残]、边注[残]、T99，音写lomar uengan ca-xiau未能解，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 担（原字「擔」）：担受、承担（挑担；担受辛苦）
entries.en: to carry on the shoulder; to bear, take upon oneself (擔)
entries.notes: M末二音节[疑:voa/hoa]且T99；tam=擔与sufrir承担义相合。

entries.zh: 忍：忍耐（忍气耐心受之）
entries.en: to endure patiently; forbearance (忍, 忍耐)
entries.notes: M末音节[疑:jionn/con]且T99；xim nay=忍耐，与sufrir con paciencia相合。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕西栏义为「忍受、克制自守」，汉字「思」与音写不合
entries.en: gloss doubtful; Spanish reads 'to suffer, hold oneself back' (sufrir detenerse) while the Chinese column 思 is inconsistent with the transcription
entries.notes: 「思」对音当为su，与音写lun lun chuy…不合，另有[疑:voa/noa]及T99，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 克：刻苦耐劳、忍受辛劳（受苦）
entries.en: to endure toil and hardship (sufrir trabajo); 克 to bear, subdue
entries.notes: T99且音写cam cam与「克」对音未合，仅西栏sufrir trabajo义清晰。

entries.zh: 量：气量、度量（容受辛劳苦楚之量）
entries.en: measure, capacity; breadth of mind (气量) — how much hardship one can bear
entries.notes: 西栏degransu frimiento当为de gran sufrimiento之连写，依赖推断；liang=量与他栏相合。

entries.zh: 宽（原字「寬」）：宽宏、宽大（有肚量，宽心承受）
entries.en: broad-minded, magnanimous; to bear with a generous spirit (寬, 寬量/寬大)
entries.notes: 仅音调未定（T99）致降；cuan=寬与sufrir con animo y pecho相合。

entries.zh: 忍耐：忍耐、忍受（耐心承受）
entries.en: to endure, bear; patience (忍耐)
entries.notes: 仅音调未定（T99）致降；xim nay=忍耐，L/H/M三栏清晰相合。

entries.zh: 从容：从容镇静、不慌不忙（从容承受）
entries.en: calm, composed, unhurried; to bear with equanimity (從容)

entries.zh: 吞忍：忍气吞声、含忍（次字疑为「忍/忽」）
entries.en: to swallow and endure in silence (吞忍); second character uncertain [忍/忽]
entries.notes: 次字[疑:忍/忽]且T99；音写nun lun与第7条互证。
